text: Concord returned to its place amidst the tents . For a while she lay in her chair in happy dreamy pleasure at son and bird and tree. And the gardeners boy chopped the tree into small pieces. There was a whole heap lying there. Concord returned to its place amidst the tents. For a while she lay in her chair in happy dreamy pleasure at son and bird and tree.
